name: noeon-ael
description: Noeon AI - The world's first cognitive programming language with a Unified Cognitive Kernel. All programs (AEL contracts + cognitive flows) compile to a single Cognitive IR and execute through one brain-inspired kernel. Features: formal type system, standard library, module system, REPL, observability, CLI toolchain, and 550+ passing tests.

scripts.test: node tests/kernel.test.js && node tests/cognitive.test.js && node tests/cognitive-v04.test.js && node tests/cognitive-v05.test.js && node tests/cognitive-v06.test.js && npm run conformance
scripts.conformance:init: npm run conformance > artifacts/conformance.last.txt 2>&1 && npm run conformance:summary -- --init
